entries.causal_hypothesis: Loss amplification may arise from prospectively observable portfolio sequences—especially repeated realized losses within a session—rather than from concurrent or same-direction exposure itself.
entries.decision: Advance SESSION_LOSS_CAP_2 to a separately preregistered Phase 2 confirmation only. Do not implement in MT4 or access 2025. Broad concurrency, same-direction, cross-strategy, drawdown, entry-cooldown and shock controls are rejected under the tested contracts.
falsified_or_unsupported_claims: Concurrent exposure is generally a loss amplifier.
Same-direction overlap should be capped globally.
B02/F05 overlap is predominantly duplicate risk.
Any drawdown-state entry should be suppressed.
Shock or post-shock exposure should be broadly capped under the common M15 proxy.
Large oracle loss-cluster coverage is directly implementable.
entries.origin_analysis: Impact Atlas identified a large portfolio-level loss surface, while prior HYP-006 had already falsified simple F05 static overlap/ordinal blocking. The user directed an independent event-sequence study across B02/F05 without changing Entry, Exit, SL or TP.
pre_result_predictions: Losses will be concentrated in multi-trade portfolio events.
At least one implementable exposure-control family may reduce DD while retaining at least 90% of winner profit.
Broad concurrency and overlap caps must be rejected if DD reduction is purchased by material winner damage.
Any retained family must show fold, strategy, side, session and month breadth rather than pooled improvement alone.
prohibited_reuse: Do not treat the perfect loss-cluster avoidance oracle as implementable performance.
Do not retune the session loss threshold, session definition, side, strategy or fold from Phase 1 outcomes.
Do not reopen static overlap/ordinal grids from HYP-006.
Do not implement broad concurrency, same-direction, B02/F05 exclusivity, drawdown or shock caps from their DD headline.
Do not access 2025 or MT4 before a separate unchanged Phase 2 protocol passes.
retained_findings: Loss-cluster events cover 86.8% of gross loss but also carry substantial winner profit.
Standalone trades were materially worse than non-standalone trades in this population.
Entries after two prior same-session realized losses form a narrow prospective adverse state: 27 entries, PF 0.352, net -5585 JPY.
SESSION_LOSS_CAP_2 improved pooled net by 5585 JPY, reduced M15 DD by 3717 JPY, retained 99.29% of winner profit and lost no top-20 winner.
The candidate remains uncertain because 2024H1 was negative, Long-side pooled delta was negative, and event-bootstrap CI touched zero.
successor_questions: Does SESSION_LOSS_CAP_2 retain net and DD benefit in at least three folds under an exact Phase 2 confirmation?
Is the benefit broad enough across Long/Short and Tokyo/London rather than driven by Short-side losses?
Can Research-to-MT4 session and realized-loss state be proven exactly before any 2025 gate?
target_failure_mode: entries after repeated same-session realized losses
